headline: Topline Beat but Margin Headwinds Persist across Segments

highlights: Ltd.—Research Analyst - INH000000222 | Email: institutional.equities@choiceindia.com Q2FY27 Result Update Hindware Home Innovation: Recovery Continues despite Margin Pressure Institutional Equities | Building Materials Topline Beat but Margin Headwinds Persist across Segments HINDWARE’s consolidated revenue grew ~14.0% YoY, supported by performance of Plastic Pipes and Bathware segments.
However, EBITDA margin contracted ~121 bps YoY, missing estimate by ~204 bps, although the company reported a second consecutive quarter of profits.
Bathware segment revenue grew ~10.8% YoY; however, margin remained flat YoY and declined 120 bps QoQ.
Volume growth for Pipes segment stood out at ~19.3% YoY and realisation improved QoQ supporting a margin recovery to ~3.5%.
valuation: View & Valuation We believe HINDWARE is poised for a gradual turnaround over the next 2–3 years, driven by improving profitability across segments, operating efficiency and a significant recovery in return ratios.
We value the company at 8.0x FY28E EV/EBITDA, which we believe is conservative, considering the expected improvement in ROCE from 6.5% in FY26 to 19.0% in FY29E.
Our revised TP implies an upside of 27.9%, while our estimate indicates consolidated Revenue / EBITDA CAGR of ~14% / ~30% over FY26–FY29E, respectively.
